plain: Disagreeing in a harsh, clashing way.

webster.text: Disagreeing; incongruous; contradictory; being at variance; as discordant opinions; discordant rules or principles.

example.quote: Who will undertake to unite the discordant opinions of a whole community, in the same judgment of it; and to prevail upon one conceited projector to renounce his INFALLIBLE criterion for the FALLIBLE criterion of his more CONCEITED NEIGHBOR?
